atoms.text: This weekend, Nathan went to the beach with his father and their dog Lucky. Nathan was very excited because he had never seen the ocean before. It was a sunny day, so they packed their swimming trunks, towels, water and food into a big bag. Then they went to the beach.

atoms.text: Although the sun was shining, and it was a warm day, they still could not go for a long swim because the water was pretty cold. The only one who did not mind the cold water was Lucky. Instead, Nathan ate a lot of ice cream and played games with his father. After a long day at the beach, the three of them went home with big smiles on their faces.
